import numpy as np, csv
with open('time_series_data.csv') as f:
    rd=list(csv.reader(f))
hdr=rd[0]
data={h:[r[i] for r in rd[1:]] for i,h in enumerate(hdr)}
def col(h):
    return np.array([np.nan if x in ('','nan','NaN','NA') else float(x) for x in data[h]])
CE=col('CE')
caps=['HatchetSword','Dagger','HouseSize','CopperGold','Amber','MonumentCount','Depot','Sickle','AxesCelts','MonumentSize','PotteryForm','PotteryDecoration']
IN=[col(c+'_inter') for c in caps]
X=np.column_stack(IN)
print("nan per col:", {c:int(np.isnan(v).sum()) for c,v in zip(caps,IN)})

def pca(Xm, cols):
    Xs=(Xm-Xm.mean(0))/Xm.std(0,ddof=1)
    Xc=Xs-Xs.mean(0)
    U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(Xc, full_matrices=False)
    ev=S**2; evr=ev/ev.sum()
    scores=U*S
    return scores, Vt, evr

# full-series PCA
fm=~np.isnan(X).any(axis=1)
Xf=X[fm]; CEf=CE[fm]
Sc,Vt,evr=pca(Xf,caps)
print("full n=",Xf.shape[0])
print("explained var ratio PC1-5:", np.round(evr[:5],4))
for i in range(3):
    print(f"PC{i+1} loadings:", {c:round(v,3) for c,v in zip(caps,Vt[i])})

oba=((CEf<=-1200)&(CEf>=-1600))
pa=((CEf<=-1500)&(CEf>=-1600))   # early 1600-1500 BCE
py=((CEf<=-1200)&(CEf>=-1400))   # young 1400-1200 BCE
print("n early",pa.sum(),"n young",py.sum())
for i in range(3):
    s=Sc[:,i]
    print(f"PC{i+1}: early mean {s[pa].mean():.4f} (sd {s[pa].std(ddof=1):.4f}) young mean {s[py].mean():.4f} (sd {s[py].std(ddof=1):.4f}) delta {s[py].mean()-s[pa].mean():.4f} pct {(s[py].mean()-s[pa].mean())/abs(s[pa].mean())*100:.2f}%")
# per-century means
edges=[-1600,-1500,-1400,-1300,-1200]
for a,b in zip(edges[:-1],edges[1:]):
    m=(CEf>a)&(CEf<=b) if a!=-1600 else (CEf>=a)&(CEf<=b)
    if m.sum()>0:
        print(f"BCE {-a}-{-b}: n={m.sum()} PC1 {Sc[m,0].mean():.4f} PC2 {Sc[m,1].mean():.4f} PC3 {Sc[m,2].mean():.4f}")
# OLS beta PC1 ~ phase indicator (young=1)
import numpy.linalg as la
y=Sc[pa|py,0]; x=(py[pa|py]).astype(float)
Xd=np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x)),x])
beta=la.lstsq(Xd,y,rcond=None)[0]
print("OLS PC1 ~ young_indicator beta:",beta, "n=",len(x))
